title: Checks and Audits on CHAS Subsidy Calculations
what_it_is: Checks and Audits on CHAS Subsidy Calculations

sections.label: CHAS subsidy IT error questions
sections.summary: Questions to the Minister for Health cover IT checks, cost recovery from the vendor, outsourcing principles and review of means-testing systems after inaccurate CHAS subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health in light of the IT error in the provision of CHAS subsidies (a) how frequently are checks for accuracy and reliability performed on such IT systems and how are these checks performed; (b) to what extent will the costs of incorrectly providing higher subsidy tiers be recoverable from the system vendor; (c) what are the principles determining which healthcare IT systems are outsourced; and (d) whether the outsourcing of means-testing IT systems will be reviewed so as to build key competencies within the Government.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health concerning the computer system error resulting in inaccurate CHAS subsidies being given to 7,700 recipients (a) whether there was feedback by the recipients about the errors; (b) if so, how was the feedback responded to; (c) how was the computer system error discovered; and (d) what was the cost of the error to the Ministry.

sections.label: Wrong file version uploaded
sections.summary: One file uploaded by NCS to a server during the migration was of a wrong version.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong
sentences.text: One of the files uploaded by NCS to one of the servers during the migration was of a wrong version.

sections.label: Higher subsidies not returned
sections.summary: Most affected individuals received higher subsidies and need not return them; the amount is estimated at about $2 million, which is being discussed with NCS for recovery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong
sentences.text: The majority of the affected individuals received higher subsidies and they do not need to return the subsidies disbursed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong
sentences.text: We estimate the amount to be about $2 million, and we are in discussions with NCS to recover the amount from them.

sections.label: Quality assurance and testing changes
sections.summary: An independent Quality Assurance review will be implemented for every major system change, testing and deployment will be partly automated, and lessons will be used to build a stronger system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong
sentences.text: For example, we will be implementing an independent Quality Assurance review for every major system change henceforth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong
sentences.text: We will also look into automating some parts of our testing and deployment processes, including the detection of anomalous transaction outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong
sentences.text: We will continue to learn from our experiences to build a stronger and more robust system.

sections.label: Two million dollars total cost
sections.summary: The $2 million estimated would approximate all costs involved in correcting the error, in terms of scale, remediation efforts and cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In terms of the scale of the error and the remediation efforts that are taken, and the cost that it will take, the $2 million that I estimated would approximate all the costs that would be involved in correcting this error.

sections.label: Recovery sum discussed with vendor
sections.summary: The $2 million covers estimated remediation cost, and the sum is being worked out with the vendor, since honouring erroneous subsidy levels may grant further higher subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: As far as the extent of recovery is concerned, as I had mentioned, the $2 million would cover an estimate of what it would cost to remediate this problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: As Assoc Prof Theseira appreciates, if we keep the subsidy level and honour the subsidy level despite it being erroneous, there will continue to be a degree to which further subsidies that were higher than what they were supposed to be, might be granted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And so, we are looking at all of this with the vendor and working out the sum that would approximate all of this and come to an arrangement with the vendor.
